title: Fixed Hadamard basis plus sparse conditioned Mirror refinement
hypothesis: For four context transforms generated as a fixed Hadamard matrix plus eight shared-support sparse perturbations, sparse Mirror codes recover >=90% of dense residual held-out operator fit quality with <40% dense residual payload bytes and condition number <=2 in every context.
mirror_coordinate: four context-specific value vectors on eight shared sparse matrix coordinates
controls: sparse Mirror refinement projected to condition number <=2

task.teacher: fixed normalized Hadamard plus context-specific small values at shared sparse coordinates

development.selection_metric: lowest validation normalized RMSE subject to condition number <=2

paid_objects: all learned residual values or factors

success_gate: Conditioned sparse Mirror fresh mean normalized RMSE <=10% of dense-residual normalized RMSE, actual bytes <40% of dense residual bytes, and max condition number <=2; compare with rank-2 residual at its actual bytes.
failure_gate: Any quality, byte, or stability gate misses, or a simpler control weakly dominates Mirror at comparable bytes.
boundaries: Aligned support shared across contexts and worlds; natural sparse support discovery is not tested.
Synthetic operator reconstruction, not a neural network task.
